D: Vampire flatmates in Wellington deal with chores, rivals and a new recruit.
P: Serve the hot chips when Nick tries to eat one.
S: Thick double-fried chips served with garlic mayo
Thick chips fried twice until crunchy, salted hot and served in a paper cone, with aioli for the humans.
Roasted beetroot, goat's cheese and blood orange on toasted baguette
Toasted baguette with whipped goat's cheese, roasted beetroot and blood orange segments, a drizzle of honey.
a snack the flatmates could actually stand

Grilled ciabatta piled with marinated cherry tomatoes and torn burrata, finished with basil, olive oil and flaky salt, not a clove of garlic in sight. Halve 400g mixed cherry tomatoes and toss with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, torn basil and salt. Leave 15 minutes. Slice 1 ciabatta into 12 thick slices, brush with olive oil and grill or chargrill 2 minutes a side until marked. Tear 2 burrata balls (about 250g) over the toasts, spoon the tomatoes and their juices on top, and finish with more basil, a drizzle of oil and flaky salt.
M: Rare sirloin sliced thin in soft rolls with horseradish cream
Beef sirloin seared and roasted rare, rested, sliced thin and piled into soft rolls with horseradish cream and rocket.
Black pudding with mash and onion gravy
a properly dark supper for the flat

Thick slices of black pudding fried crisp, over buttery mash with caramelised onions, red wine gravy and a sharp apple and parsley salad. Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter for 25 minutes until golden. Stir in 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock and simmer 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk. Slice 500g black pudding 1.5cm thick and fry in a little oil 2 minutes a side until crisp. Toss 1 thinly sliced green apple with parsley and lemon. Serve the pudding on the mash with the gravy and salad.
W: Chocolate sponge, morello cherries, whipped cream and dark chocolate
Chocolate sponge soaked in cherry syrup, layered with morello cherries and whipped cream, then covered all over in dark chocolate shavings.
K: Fresh blood orange juice topped with soda water over ice
Blood orange juice over ice topped with soda water and a slice of orange, alcohol-free.

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thick chips, soak and dry.
Fry at 150C, rest, then fry at 190C until crunchy. Salt well.
Mix the mayonnaise with crushed garlic and a squeeze of lemon for aioli.
Serve the aioli on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Beetroot up to 2 days ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast at 200C.
Cool, peel and dice.
Slice the baguette into rounds and toast.
Spread with goat's cheese, top with beetroot and blood orange segments and drizzle with honey.

dishes.make_ahead: Beef up to 1 day ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Season the beef and sear on all sides in a hot pan.
Roast at 200C for rare.
Rest the beef, then slice thin.
Fill the rolls with beef, horseradish cream and a handful of rocket each.
Whisk the eggs and sugar until thick, then fold in the flour and cocoa.
Bake in a 20cm tin at 180C.
Cool completely.
Split the cake in two and soak with the cherry syrup.
Whip the cream, fill with cherries and cream, cover in cream and grate dark chocolate on top.
Squeeze 6 of the blood oranges.
Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and pour the juice into each.
Top with soda water and finish with a slice of blood orange on the rim.

s.note: Thick double-fried chips served with garlic mayo
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thick chips, soak and dry. Fry at 150C for 6 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C for 3 minutes until crunchy and salt well. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 1 crushed garlic clove and a squeeze of lemon for aioli and serve on the side.

s.note: Roasted beetroot, goat's cheese and blood orange on toasted baguette
s.how: Wrap 2 beetroot in foil and roast at 200C for 50 minutes, cool, peel and dice. Slice 1 baguette into 16 rounds and toast. Spread with 150g goat's cheese, top with the beetroot and segments from 2 blood oranges, and drizzle with honey.

m.note: Rare sirloin sliced thin in soft rolls with horseradish cream
m.how: Season 800g beef sirloin, sear on all sides in a hot pan, then roast at 200C for 18 minutes for rare. Rest 15 minutes and slice thin. Fill 4 soft rolls with the beef, 4 tbsp horseradish cream and a handful of rocket each.

w.note: Chocolate sponge, morello cherries, whipped cream and dark chocolate
w.how: Whisk 4 eggs and 150g sugar until thick, fold in 100g self-raising flour and 30g cocoa, and bake in a 20cm tin at 180C for 25 minutes. Split in two, soak with the syrup from a 680g jar of morello cherries, fill with cherries and 300ml whipped cream, cover in cream and grate 50g dark chocolate on top.

d.note: Fresh blood orange juice topped with soda water over ice
d.how: Squeeze 6 blood oranges. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice, pour 70ml juice into each and top with 150ml soda water. Finish with a slice of blood orange on the rim.
